protocol: Two prespecified bounded residual coefficients.21-point grid per coefficient; equally weighted training direction accuracy and balanced materiality, then direct-size accuracy, fewer false positives and minimum correction. Same family splits; cached v18 base fits exclude validation families. Residual fitting train-only. Models differ in data access: frozen v18 uses old evidence; corrections learn v19 training rows. Exploratory, not new prospective accuracy. No parameter selection on outer test labels. Delivery gates applied to outer metrics; repeated reuse limits independence.
